tools.name: Sheet Metal Gauge Converter
tools.description: Convert sheet metal gauge to inches and mm, or find the nearest gauge for a thickness, using separate steel, galvanized, stainless and aluminium tables.

tools.name: Cone Flat Pattern Calculator
tools.description: Develop a cone or frustum into a flat sheet layout: outer and inner radii, arc angle, chords and multi-segment patterns, drawn to scale, from diameters and height.

tools.name: Press Brake Tonnage Calculator
tools.description: Estimate press brake force for air bending, bottoming or coining from thickness, V-die opening, bend length and tensile strength, with radius and flange rules.

tools.name: Punching Force Calculator
tools.description: Work out the force to punch or blank round, square, rectangular or slotted holes from perimeter, sheet thickness and shear strength, in kN, US tons and tonnes.

tools.name: Fillet Weld Size and Strength Calculator
tools.description: Size a fillet weld or check its strength with AISC 360 LRFD and ASD rules, including load angle, and estimate the weld metal and filler wire or rod needed.

tools.name: Engine Displacement Calculator
tools.description: Engine displacement in cc, litres and cubic inches from bore, stroke and cylinders, with overbore, bore or stroke for a target size and bore/stroke ratio.

tools.name: Compression Ratio Calculator
tools.description: Static compression ratio from bore, stroke, chamber cc, head gasket, deck clearance and piston dish or dome, plus dynamic CR from rod length and intake closing.

tools.name: Horsepower Calculator
tools.description: Horsepower from torque and rpm, or estimated from weight with quarter-mile ET or trap speed, plus kW, PS and crank versus wheel horsepower after drivetrain loss.

tools.name: Gear Speed Calculator
tools.description: Road speed in every gear from rpm, gearbox ratios, final drive and tyre size, with rpm at cruising speed, rpm drop on each upshift and an rpm versus speed chart.

tools.name: Fuel Injector Size Calculator
tools.description: Find the injector size for your horsepower target from BSFC, injector count and duty cycle, in lb/hr and cc/min, with fuel pressure, E85 and wheel hp corrections.

tools.name: Coin Toss
tools.description: Flip a virtual coin and get heads or tails from your browser's cryptographic random generator, with a running tally of flips and percentages.

tools.name: Spin Wheel
tools.description: Type a list, build a colour wheel and spin it for a random winner. Pick a 10 to 60 second spin, share the wheel by link, or show it full screen.

tools.name: Team Lunch Decider
tools.description: Add the places your team is considering, press Make the Decision! and get one restaurant after a 10 to 20 second drum roll. Every option has equal odds.

tools.name: Drum Roll Decider
tools.description: List any options, press the button and get one fair random pick after a drum roll and shuffle. Built for live reveals in meetings, classes and stand-ups.

tools.name: Group Splitter
tools.description: Paste a list of names and split it into random, round-robin or in-order groups by size or count. Group sizes never differ by more than one person.

tools.name: Random Picker
tools.description: Pick one item, several at once or a full random order from a list. Draws without repeats track who is left, and raffle numbers can be generated.

tools.name: Dice Roller
tools.description: Roll any dice online, from a single d20 to 3d6+2 or 4d6 drop lowest, with fair crypto-random rolls, a roll history and the exact odds of every total.

tools.name: Tournament Bracket Generator
tools.description: Make a seeded single or double elimination bracket with byes, or a round robin schedule, for 2 to 128 players. Click winners to fill it in, then print it.

tools.name: Score Keeper
tools.description: Track scores for any card or board game: players, round-by-round scores, running totals, ties and a winner, with highest or lowest wins. Saved in your browser.

tools.name: Tetris
tools.description: Play falling-block Tetris with keyboard controls, a next-piece preview, levels that speed up every 10 lines and an optional 1 to 10 minute time limit.

tools.name: Snake Game
tools.description: Steer the snake with arrow keys or WASD, eat food to grow and avoid your own tail. Optional wall wrapping, three themes and a timed or endless mode.

tools.name: Helicopter Game
tools.description: Hold to climb and release to drop as a helicopter flies through a scrolling cave full of blocks. Four difficulty levels, distance scoring and a best score.

tools.name: 2048 Game
tools.description: Slide numbered tiles on a 4x4 grid and merge equal pairs to build a 2048 tile. Arrow keys or on-screen arrows, auto-save, best score and a move timer.

tools.name: Wordle Game
tools.description: Guess a hidden five-letter word in six tries with green, yellow and grey hints, correct duplicate-letter scoring and saved stats. Unlimited games, no daily wait.

tools.name: Fifteen Puzzle
tools.description: Slide numbered tiles into order on grids from 2x2 to 12x12. Every shuffle is checked to be solvable, with a move counter and timer for each attempt.

tools.name: Sudoku
tools.description: Play freshly generated Sudoku with exactly one solution at four difficulty levels. Mistakes show in red, progress auto-saves, and puzzles export to PDF.

tools.name: Minesweeper
tools.description: Classic Minesweeper with Beginner, Intermediate and Expert boards, a guaranteed safe first click that opens an area, flags, sound and a saved game.

tools.name: Bug on Wire
tools.description: Move a bug between four vertical wires to dodge birds diving from above. Speed and bird count climb every few seconds; mouse or arrow keys to play.

tools.name: Breakout
tools.description: Play Breakout with mouse, touch or arrow keys. Arcade scoring from red 7 to yellow 1, four speed-ups, a paddle that shrinks at the top wall, and endless levels.

tools.name: Fullscreen Celebration Effects
tools.description: Fill your screen with confetti, balloons, fireworks or a candle you can blow out. Made for team wins, launches and parties on a big display.

tools.name: Random Joke Generator
tools.description: Get a random programming joke or a clean everyday pun with one click, copy it for chat, or save it as a picture card. About 490 jokes, no repeats in a row.

tools.name: Online Fortune Cookie
tools.description: Crack a virtual fortune cookie for today's message. You get the same fortune all day and a new one after local midnight. Copy it or save it as an image.

tools.name: Online Piano Keyboard
tools.description: Play an 18-key piano from C4 to F5 with your computer keyboard or mouse, follow seven simple songs note by note, and record what you play.

tools.name: Happy Birthday Song With Name
tools.description: Type a name to play Happy Birthday on a small piano, then share a link that plays it for them with balloons, fireworks and a card, or download a WAV.

tools.name: Would You Rather Questions
tools.description: Random would you rather questions for kids, families, work teams and parties, from an original list, shuffled so none repeat until you have seen them all.

tools.name: Interactive 3D Earth Globe
tools.description: Spin a 3D Earth, click any of 194 countries for its capital, population, currency and languages, and open a fullscreen view for a classroom screen.

tools.name: Mindless Activities for Stress Relief
tools.description: Thirteen low-effort screen activities for a short break: pop bubbles, follow a breathing circle, watch a pendulum, place stars or melt ice off a 3D Earth.

tools.name: Launch Readiness Checklist for Vibe-Coded Apps
tools.description: Work through 35 pre-launch checks an AI builder skips: row-level security, exposed API keys, backups that restore, failure cases, alerting and getting your code out.

tools.name: International Travel Checklist
tools.description: Documents, money, health and home, ordered by deadline: passport validity, visas, vaccinations, insurance and the day-of rules. Tick, edit and download as PDF.

tools.name: Carry-On Packing Checklist
tools.description: Travel with a cabin bag only: the liquid and battery rules that are actually enforced, the size limit that varies by airline, and how to pack a week in one bag.

tools.name: Road Trip Checklist
tools.description: Ten minutes of car checks that prevent most breakdowns, the route items people forget, and the cover that stops at the border without telling you.

tools.name: Flying With a Baby Checklist
tools.description: A baby needs their own passport, baby milk is exempt from the liquid limit, bassinets are limited and not guaranteed, and only labelled car seats go on board.

tools.name: Camping Checklist
tools.description: Cold comes from the ground, not the air, so the mat matters more than the bag. Pitch at home first, never run a stove in a tent, and pack dry clothes for sleeping.

tools.name: Hiking Time Calculator
tools.description: Estimate walking time from distance and ascent with Naismith's rule, then correct for the descent the way Langmuir does. Shows the working.

tools.name: Day Hike Checklist
tools.description: Most rescue callouts happen in the afternoon, on the way down. Set a turnaround time, carry a head torch, and pack for the night you do not plan to spend out.

tools.name: Travelling With Pets Checklist
tools.description: Rabies vaccination has a waiting period, some countries need a blood test months ahead, and the microchip must come first. Getting the order wrong means quarantine.

tools.name: Long-Haul Flight Checklist
tools.description: Three real problems: immobility raises clot risk, cabin air dehydrates, and time zones cost days. Walk hourly, take an aisle seat, and get daylight on arrival.

tools.name: Ski Trip Checklist
tools.description: Standard travel insurance usually excludes skiing, off-piste is often excluded too, and arriving high by cable car gives your body no time to acclimatise.

tools.name: Business Trip Checklist
tools.description: A business visa that needed weeks and expenses refused because nobody read the policy are the two failures. Both are cheap to check before you book.

tools.name: Beach Holiday Checklist
tools.description: Three real risks and the rest is packing. Most people apply far less sunscreen than tested, rip currents should not be fought, and cloud does not protect you.

tools.name: Child Travel Documents Checklist
tools.description: Taking a child abroad needs permission from everyone with parental responsibility. Borders ask for proof of relationship, which catches different surnames.

tools.name: Passport Renewal Checklist
tools.description: Many countries need six months of validity beyond your return, so a passport expiring in five is effectively expired. Plus the photo rules that cause most delays.

tools.name: Winter Driving Checklist
tools.description: The decision not to drive matters more than any technique. Then visibility, stopping distance, and being equipped to sit still for hours with the exhaust clear.

tools.name: Winter Home Checklist
tools.description: Prepare a house for winter: carbon monoxide alarms, boiler service, frozen pipe prevention, gutters and draughts, ordered by consequence. Tick, edit and download.

tools.name: Moving House Checklist
tools.description: Six weeks out to the first night in: mail redirection, meter readings, broadband lead times, insurance that has to start at exchange, and changing the locks.

tools.name: Power Outage Checklist
tools.description: What to have ready before a power cut, what to do in the first hour, the heating improvisations that kill people, and the four-hour rule for refrigerated food.

tools.name: Blackout Preparedness Checklist
tools.description: Six cumulative tiers of supplies, from 12 hours to 90 days: a gallon of water per person per day, how to stock it so it rotates, and how to ration so it lasts.

tools.name: Home Fire Safety Checklist
tools.description: Alarms on every level, tested monthly and replaced at ten years, an escape route everyone has walked in the dark, and the causes behind most house fires.

tools.name: Home Security Checklist
tools.description: Most burglaries are opportunistic and many involve no force at all. Anti-snap cylinders, locked windows, sensor lighting and a house that looks lived in do the work.

tools.name: Storm Preparation Checklist
tools.description: Loose objects outside cause most of the damage, floodwater causes most of the deaths, and falling debris catches people who went out too early afterwards.

tools.name: Annual Home Maintenance Checklist
tools.description: Houses fail slowly then suddenly. Alarms and appliance servicing, gutters and the stopcock, damp and ventilation, and the records that make a claim or a sale easy.

tools.name: Wildfire Preparation Checklist
tools.description: Most homes are lost to embers landing in gutters and under decking, not a wall of flame. Clear the first few metres, screen the vents, and plan to leave early.

tools.name: Rental Move-Out Checklist
tools.description: Deposit disputes are won on evidence: the move-in photographs, notice given in the right form, dated photos of every room, and final meter readings.

tools.name: Spring Cleaning Checklist
tools.description: Never mix bleach with ammonia or acids, fix the cause of mould rather than cleaning it, damp dust where anyone has asthma, and check every expiry date.

tools.name: Flood Preparation Checklist
tools.description: Never drive or walk through floodwater: most flood deaths are in vehicles. Check your risk, register for warnings, and expect recovery to take months.

tools.name: Rental Move-In Checklist
tools.description: Read the joint liability clause before signing, amend the inventory rather than signing it blind, and get the gas, electrical and deposit paperwork on day one.

tools.name: Home Energy Saving Checklist
tools.description: Draughts and insulation first, then controls, then appliances. Plus the ventilation warning: sealing a house without it causes mould that costs more than heating.

tools.name: Home Inventory Checklist
tools.description: After a fire or burglary you are asked to list what you owned, from memory, while distressed. A video walkthrough and a room-by-room list prevent that.

tools.name: New Baby Checklist
tools.description: What a newborn needs on day one, what people buy far too early, and the paperwork with legal deadlines: registering the birth, benefits, insurance and leave.

tools.name: What To Do When Someone Dies Checklist
tools.description: Almost nothing has to be done tonight. What does: verification, the medical certificate, registering within the legal deadline, and the accounts that come after.

tools.name: Wedding Planning Checklist
tools.description: The notice period that can stop a wedding, the money conversation to have before any decision, and the suppliers that can only serve one wedding a day.

tools.name: Buying a Used Car Checklist
tools.description: Outstanding finance can mean losing the car and the money. Run the history check first, insist on a cold engine, and transfer the registration before you drive away.

tools.name: Getting a Pet Checklist
tools.description: The honest questions first, because most pets are given up for foreseeable reasons. Then the paperwork, the insurance that has to start first, and the first weeks.

tools.name: Estate Planning Checklist
tools.description: Three documents do most of the work: a valid will, a power of attorney for finances and one for health. Plus the list telling someone where everything actually is.

tools.name: Caring For a Parent Checklist
tools.description: Ask for a care needs assessment and one for yourself, set up powers of attorney while they still can, and keep your money separate from theirs.

tools.name: Separation and Divorce Checklist
tools.description: A divorce ends the marriage; it does not settle the finances. Without a separate financial order, claims can be made years later, including on a pension.

tools.name: Retirement Checklist
tools.description: The decisions you cannot undo, the ones you can, and the half of retirement that is not money: routine, purpose and the social life your job was quietly supplying.

tools.name: Moving Abroad Checklist
tools.description: The expensive problems live in the gap between two countries: tax residency nobody established, healthcare nobody arranged, and a pension you can no longer pay into.

tools.name: Learning to Drive Checklist
tools.description: Licence, theory, varied practice and the test, then the part nobody prepares for: the first year alone, which carries the highest crash risk.

tools.name: First Job Checklist
tools.description: Read the written terms, check your pay is above the legal minimum, do not opt out of the pension, and know the rights that exist from day one, not after probation.

tools.name: Tax Year End Checklist
tools.description: The allowances that vanish at the deadline, the records to gather now, and the checks worth making: tax codes, thresholds, losses and instalments. Tick and export.

tools.name: Self-Employment Setup Checklist
tools.description: Register on time, put aside tax you have not been charged yet, keep records you can file from, and get the insurance and pension nobody arranges for you.

tools.name: Emergency Fund Checklist
tools.description: Work out what one month of essentials actually costs, pick a target you can reach, keep it where you will not spend it, and decide now what counts as an emergency.

tools.name: Mortgage Application Checklist
tools.description: Credit file errors take weeks to correct, three months of statements get read, gifted deposits need a letter, and nothing should change between offer and completion.

tools.name: Insurance Review Checklist
tools.description: Find the cover you are paying for twice, check buildings cover is rebuild cost not market value, read the conditions that void a claim, and never auto-renew.

tools.name: Debt Payoff Checklist
tools.description: Which debts have consequences beyond interest, why free regulated advice beats anything you pay for, and how to pick a repayment method and stop reconsidering it.

tools.name: Pension Review Checklist
tools.description: Find the pots from old jobs, check whether your employer would match more, compare the charges, and get a state pension forecast with your contribution record.

tools.name: US Retirement Records Checklist
tools.description: Check Social Security earnings, Medicare deadlines and RMD rules, then search PBGC, DOL Lost and Found and state unclaimed property for money from old jobs.

tools.name: Annual Money Review Checklist
tools.description: Most money problems are drift: an expired savings rate, a renewal that crept up, a direct debit for something cancelled years ago. An hour a year catches it.

tools.name: First Investment Account Checklist
tools.description: Clear expensive debt, keep a cash buffer, take the employer pension match, then compare fees. Plus the patterns that every investment scam shares.

tools.name: Monthly Budget Checklist
tools.description: Budgets fail on annual costs. Build from three months of real transactions, give every yearly bill its own monthly amount, and automate the day after payday.

tools.name: Invoice Chasing Checklist
tools.description: Most unpaid invoices are not disputes: wrong recipient, missing purchase order, chased once apologetically. Prevent it in the contract, then follow a schedule.

tools.name: Expense Claim Checklist
tools.description: Claims are refused because the policy did not cover it, the receipt faded, or the deadline passed. All three are decided before you submit anything.

tools.name: Employee Onboarding Checklist
tools.description: Everything before day one, during week one and across ninety days: right to work, payroll, access, a buddy and written expectations. Tick, edit and export.

tools.name: Website Launch Checklist
tools.description: Pre-launch checks that actually bite: a staging robots.txt, a stray noindex, untested forms, missing analytics, expiring certificates and who owns the domain.

tools.name: Employee Offboarding Checklist
tools.description: The access revoked on the day, the shared credentials nobody rotates, final pay including untaken holiday, and the handover asked for while they still care.

tools.name: Incident Response Checklist
tools.description: Name a commander who is not debugging, keep a timestamped log, restore service before finding the cause, and treat data as involved until you can show it is not.

tools.name: Interview Preparation Checklist
tools.description: Five two-minute stories cover most behavioural questions, one question nobody else asks comes from their last year, and the video link gets tested the day before.

tools.name: Data Protection Readiness Checklist
tools.description: Compliance starts with an inventory, not a policy: what personal data you hold, why, for how long, who else receives it, and what happens when there is a breach.

tools.name: Performance Review Checklist
tools.description: Nothing in a review should be new information, recency bias beats memory, and whatever was promised needs writing down. Covers manager and employee.

tools.name: Starting a Company Checklist
tools.description: The expensive mistakes happen in month one: the wrong structure, no founder agreement, unvested shares, and personal money mixed with the company's.

tools.name: Hiring a Tradesperson Checklist
tools.description: Write the specification, get three written quotes on it, avoid large deposits, pay traceably, and insist on certificates at the point the work is done.

tools.name: Handover Before Leave Checklist
tools.description: A handover is for the people staying. The test is whether someone could answer a customer or release a payment without reaching you, which is the point of leave.

tools.name: Product Launch Checklist
tools.description: Write the one sentence, watch five real users, brief support before launch, and decide what success looks like as a number before you ship it.

tools.name: Event Planning Checklist
tools.description: Capacity is set by exits, not chairs. Licences take weeks, allergen information is a legal duty, and the weather plan needs a decision point agreed in advance.

tools.name: Remote Onboarding Checklist
tools.description: Equipment and access before day one, because a remote starter cannot borrow a login, then the social half that an office supplied for free.

tools.name: Workplace Risk Assessment Checklist
tools.description: What could cause harm, who could be harmed, what you already do, and what else is reasonable. Plus the hierarchy of control and when to review it.

tools.name: Hospital Stay Checklist
tools.description: What to pack for hospital, the questions worth asking, and what to settle before discharge: medicines, warning signs, follow-up and the summary to take home.

tools.name: First Aid Kit Checklist
tools.description: What a home and car first aid kit should contain, what expires and when to check it, and why training matters more than the contents of the box.

tools.name: Doctor Appointment Checklist
tools.description: Ten minutes is short. Write your three concerns and the symptom timeline, bring a medicine list, ask for risks in numbers, and repeat the plan back before you leave.

tools.name: Home Fall-Proofing Checklist
tools.description: Falls are the leading cause of injury in older adults and most happen at home. Lighting, loose rugs, grab rails, footwear and the one exercise proven to reduce them.

tools.name: Medication Review Checklist
tools.description: Build the real list including supplements, then ask which you still need, what interacts, and whether a symptom is a side effect rather than a new problem.

tools.name: Sleep Checklist
tools.description: A consistent wake time beats a fixed bedtime, morning light sets the clock, lying awake in bed trains insomnia, and alcohol is a disruptor rather than an aid.

tools.name: Post-Surgery Recovery Checklist
tools.description: Arrange the lift home and the pain relief before the operation, get the warning signs in writing at discharge, and know which symptoms mean call now, not wait.

tools.name: Allergy Action Plan Checklist
tools.description: Two adrenaline injectors carried with the person, the signs that mean anaphylaxis, adrenaline given first without waiting, and never letting them stand up.

tools.name: Pregnancy Checklist by Trimester
tools.description: Book antenatal care early because screening has time windows, start folic acid now, give employer notice in the statutory window, and know the warning signs.

tools.name: Mental Health Crisis Plan Checklist
tools.description: Write it while you are well: your early warning signs, who to call in order, what helps and what does not, and what needs covering if you are unwell.

tools.name: Vaccination Records Checklist
tools.description: The record usually exists even when you cannot remember the vaccines. Where to look, how to work out what is missing, and keeping one you can actually produce.

tools.name: Starting Exercise Checklist
tools.description: The guidelines include strength work on two days, which almost nobody does. Start at half what you think you can, progress one variable at a time, and schedule it.

tools.name: New Laptop Setup Checklist
tools.description: Set up a new laptop properly: encryption and recovery keys, a password manager before you sign in anywhere, a tested backup, and wiping the old machine.

tools.name: Password and Account Security Checklist
tools.description: What current guidance actually says: length over symbols, a manager, two-factor on email first, no forced rotation, and how to get back in if you lose your phone.

tools.name: Backup Checklist (3-2-1)
tools.description: Three copies, two kinds of storage, one off-site, one with version history and one not permanently connected. Plus the restore test that proves any of it works.

tools.name: Leaving a Job: Digital Checklist
tools.description: Personal accounts on a work email, two-factor codes on a work phone, payslips in a portal that closes, and what you may and may not take with you.

tools.name: Phone Upgrade Checklist
tools.description: What goes wrong is never the photos. It is two-factor codes stranded on a wiped phone, messaging history that did not transfer, and a phone sold still signed in.

tools.name: Home Network Security Checklist
tools.description: Change the router admin password, update the firmware, turn off remote admin and WPS, and put smart devices on a guest network.

tools.name: Data Breach Response Checklist
tools.description: Your details were in a breach. Secure email first, change every reused password, then handle the slower risk of someone opening accounts in your name.

tools.name: Child Device Setup Checklist
tools.description: Child accounts and purchase controls, chat restricted inside games too, downtime rather than daily totals, and a promise that telling you never costs the device.

tools.name: Device Disposal Checklist
tools.description: Deleting files removes the index, not the data. Sign out of the platform account, remove the cards, use the built-in erase, and never bin a lithium battery.

tools.name: Account Recovery Setup Checklist
tools.description: Two-factor creates a new failure mode: lose the phone, lose the accounts. Register two methods, store recovery codes offline, and test one route.

tools.name: Subscription Audit Checklist
tools.description: Check three separate bank lists plus app stores and wallets, scan a full year for annual renewals, and cancel with the provider rather than just stopping payment.

tools.name: Smart Home Privacy Checklist
tools.description: Check the stated support period before buying, decide what each device may hear and keep, and review who else can still reach your cameras and locks.

tools.name: Job Application Checklist
tools.description: The steps people skip and regret: tailoring the top third of a CV, saving the advert, preparing five stories, deciding your number, and warning your referees.

tools.name: Exam Preparation Checklist
tools.description: Revision that works according to the research: testing yourself, spacing, past papers and interleaving, instead of rereading and highlighting. Plus the final week.

tools.name: Salary Negotiation Checklist
tools.description: Research three sources, set a walk-away and a target, let them name a number first, negotiate the whole package, and never accept on the call.

tools.name: Starting University Checklist
tools.description: Student finance deadlines, a tenancy with joint liability, vaccinations and registering with a doctor, then the first fortnight that decides the year.

tools.name: Dissertation Submission Checklist
tools.description: Ethics approval before any data, the regulations read in full months early, citations cross-checked both ways, and a submission made a day before the deadline.

tools.name: Career Change Checklist
tools.description: Separate the job from the field, talk to five people doing it, do a small piece of the real work, and work out the runway before you resign rather than after.

tools.name: Job Reference Checklist
tools.description: Ask before you name anyone, brief them properly, and know what an employer may and may not say. Plus the background checks that are not references.

tools.name: Visa Application Checklist
tools.description: Refusals are usually evidential: the wrong statement format, an uncertified translation, an unexplained gap. Use the official site and never book travel first.

tools.name: New School Year Checklist
tools.description: Applications, transport entitlement, free meal registration, medical forms and consent slips all have windows, and school admin sends almost no reminders.

tools.name: Studying Abroad Checklist
tools.description: Visa and funding have hard deadlines, financial evidence must be held for a set period, and local registration after arrival often has a short legal window.

tools.name: Job Offer Evaluation Checklist
tools.description: Pension contribution can outweigh the pay difference, notice periods and non-competes bind you, and a verbal offer is not a job. Compare the whole package.
